programs.nl_rule: The input contains a blue shape with red highlights, as well as at least one copy of these red highlights elsewhere in the grid without the (blue) rest of the shape. These highlights are placed as if the full shape had been copied, in some cases after having been magnified by an integer factor, and then the blue erased. Where these blue cells would have been erased, fill them back in using blue, resulting in a (possibly magnified) copy of the original shape. Do this for all instances of orphaned red highlights.
